{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the rows with missing flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
missing_rows = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull() | penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull()]

# Check if these rows are different in other variables
# Specifically, check if they are systematically different in species or island
print(missing_rows[['species', 'island', 'sex']])"}
